breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification correctly states that the domain height is oriented along the Y-axis, but it then incorrectly sets the gravity vector to (0 0 -9.81), which is in the Z-direction. For the dam break to work as intended in this 2D X-Y plane setup, gravity should have been corrected to (0 -9.81 0).
